en-US.whatsNew:
Frame now fits iPhone Duo, closed, open and everything in between.

• Albums spread across the whole inner display when you open the phone
• Stand it half open and photos part around the fold instead of bending over it
• Controls sit in the side bar, clear of the camera
• Latest iOS frameworks and security updates
en-US.promotionalText: Free forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no paywall, no limits. Now made for iPhone Duo, with albums that fill the whole inner display.
